estCeLeBon.introTexte: Twenty questions about how you feel with this person, about your arguments, about trust and about the future you can picture. Some weigh more than others. Answer as things are, not as you'd like them to be.
estCeLeBon.q1: When you're with them, most of the time, you feel...
estCeLeBon.q1b: Good, with ups and downs like everyone.
estCeLeBon.q2: When you argue, how does it end?
estCeLeBon.q2a: We talk it through and make up, sometimes the same day.
estCeLeBon.q2b: We each calm down on our own, then talk about it again.
estCeLeBon.q2c: One of us gives in so it stops.
estCeLeBon.q2d: It gets out of hand, or it lingers for days.
estCeLeBon.q3: Can you tell them what bothers you without being afraid of their reaction?
estCeLeBon.q3a: Yes, everything, even the delicate stuff.
estCeLeBon.q3c: I pick my words and my moments.
estCeLeBon.q4: Your life in five years: they are...
estCeLeBon.q4d: Not there, or I'd rather not think about it.
estCeLeBon.q5: Why are you with this person, honestly?
estCeLeBon.q5a: For who they are, as they are.
estCeLeBon.q5c: Because it's comfortable and it more or less works.
estCeLeBon.q5d: Out of fear of being alone, or of starting over.
estCeLeBon.q6: On the big topics (money, children, family, faithfulness), you are...
estCeLeBon.q6b: Not always agreed, but we talk about it.
estCeLeBon.q6c: At odds on things we avoid.
estCeLeBon.q7: Good news lands, or bad news. Who do you think of first?
estCeLeBon.q7c: A friend or my family first.
estCeLeBon.q8: In the small things of everyday life, you feel respected...
estCeLeBon.q9: When they tell you something, you believe it...
estCeLeBon.q9b: Yes, except on one or two subjects.
estCeLeBon.q9d: With difficulty: I've been betrayed before, and nothing has changed.
estCeLeBon.q10: Your doubts about this relationship come...
estCeLeBon.q10b: After an argument, then they pass.
estCeLeBon.q10d: All the time, in the background.
estCeLeBon.q11: When something goes well for you, they...
estCeLeBon.q11a: Are the first person to be happy about it.
estCeLeBon.q11b: Are pleased, without making much of it.
estCeLeBon.q11d: Play it down, or it annoys them.
estCeLeBon.q12: Do you feel free to be yourself (your tastes, your friends, your time alone)?
estCeLeBon.q12b: Mostly, with the normal compromises of living as a couple.
estCeLeBon.q12c: I hold back on some things.
estCeLeBon.q13: After a busy week, the thought of seeing them again...
estCeLeBon.q13d: I'd rather have a breather on my own.
estCeLeBon.q14: Your friends and family, and them:
estCeLeBon.q14a: They adore them, and I get why.
estCeLeBon.q14c: They're reserved, without quite saying so.
estCeLeBon.q15a: Very much there, even with time.
estCeLeBon.q15c: Rare, but we manage to talk about it.
estCeLeBon.q15d: Absent, and we don't talk about it.
estCeLeBon.q16: The effort to keep the relationship alive:
estCeLeBon.q16a: Shared, without having to keep count.
estCeLeBon.q16b: A bit uneven depending on the period.
estCeLeBon.q16d: It's mostly me, and I'm getting tired.
estCeLeBon.q17b: We negotiate, and it goes fine.
estCeLeBon.q17c: It's often the same one who decides.
estCeLeBon.q18: If you could go back to day one, knowing everything you know today:
estCeLeBon.q18a: I'd do the same, without hesitating.
estCeLeBon.q18b: I'd do the same, changing two or three things.
estCeLeBon.q19a: Little things, they mostly make me smile.
estCeLeBon.q19b: A few things, I live with them.
estCeLeBon.q20: Compared with your past relationships, this one is...
estCeLeBon.q20c: The same, with the same problems.
estCeLeBon.r1_d: Your answers almost all point the same way, and it isn't a good one: you're on your guard, arguments leave marks, you keep what bothers you to yourself, and a future with this person is hard to picture. This isn't a passing doubt. When someone answers twenty questions in a row like this, they've already understood something, and they're still looking for a reason not to see it.
estCeLeBon.r1_a: Don't decide anything tonight, but don't let it slide either. Write down what you accept in this relationship that you wouldn't accept for a close friend. Most of the time, the list speaks for itself. And if fear or contempt are part of everyday life, this is no longer a question of "the right person": talk to someone you trust, or a professional, without waiting.
estCeLeBon.r2_t: A lot of doubts for one relationship
estCeLeBon.r2_d: There's good in your answers, otherwise you wouldn't still be here. But the doubts come back often, trust isn't complete, and on one or two important subjects you feel you're not on the same line. It isn't necessarily the wrong person. It's a relationship where you protect yourself more than you settle in, and the score shows it.
estCeLeBon.r2_a: Pick the question where your own answer hurt the most to read, and talk about it with them this week. Not to fix everything at once, but to see how they take what you say. Their reaction will tell you more than any test. If it's good, take the test again in two months. If it isn't, you'll have your answer.
estCeLeBon.r3_t: A real relationship, with things to sort out
estCeLeBon.r3_d: You're good with this person, you trust them on the whole, and you can picture a future. What brings the score down is two or three precise answers: an argument that ends badly, a subject you avoid, effort that isn't very shared. Nothing that condemns a relationship. But nothing that sorts itself out either.
estCeLeBon.r3_a: Look at the questions where you chose the third answer. Those are the ones that matter now. Take just one, the most concrete, and put it on the table without blame: "I'd like us to decide that together", "I need us to talk about it again when we're calm". A couple where things get said is a couple with room to move, and you have some.
estCeLeBon.r4_d: Your score is high, and it's deserved: you feel where you belong, you can tell them anything, you trust them and you see them in your life in five years. Little is missing, and that little shows in one or two answers. Maybe a reserved family, desire in a dip right now, or a small list of annoyances that keeps growing.
estCeLeBon.r4_a: Don't let those one or two answers become a subject you avoid. Say what you've noticed, simply, when it happens rather than as a review. And enjoy the rest! What you're describing, many people look for a long time.
estCeLeBon.r5_d: Your answers say the same thing from start to finish: you're calm with this person, disagreements get repaired, you tell them everything, you trust them, and if you had to do it again, you'd do the same without hesitating. No test can promise the future. But everything that can be looked at today is there, and firmly so.
estCeLeBon.r5_a: Keep what makes it work, because it doesn't hold up on its own: saying things, repairing quickly after an argument, being happy for each other. And if you were asking the question out of habit, or because someone around you was asking it, you now have your answer. It's worth saying to the person concerned...
